payload.recallText: Joe has an offer to play baseball. He is excited when his mom comes in the room but he accidentally slams his arm into her and she drops and breaks a water pitcher she was getting ready to water plants with. He talks about how he is on a team with a contract but he'd like to go to another team. He talks about mabel and reggie coming to visit, but not just to see  him. He hopes they get to spend time together. The weather turns and the train is delayed.
